question.text: <math><mn>1</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">M </mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></math> and <math><mn>1</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">M </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></math> are mixed to make a total volume of <math><mn>300 </mn><mi mathvariant="normal">mL</mi></math>. If <math><mi mathvariant="normal">pH</mi></math> of the mixture is <math><mn>9.26</mn></math> and <math><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></mrow></msub><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><msubsup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo></mrow></msubsup></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>9.26</mn></math> then what would be the volume ratio of <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></math> and <math><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></math> .

solution.text:
pOH=14-pH=pKb+log⁡x300-2x
=14-9.26=-log⁡10-4.74 +log⁡x300-2x
⇒ x300-2x=1
⇒300=3x⇒x=100 mL
